extraction: Orchestration coordination cost: parallel agents add overhead — context sync (unified-memory), merge conflicts (git), review latency (Verdict queue). Formula: Total time = max(Engine_time, Verdict_time, Miss_time) + sync_overhead. For 3 engines parallel: sync_overhead ~5 min (unified-memory writes, git merges). Sequential: 3 × (Engine + Verdict + Miss). Parallel wins if Engine_time > sync_overhead. Our Engine builds ~10 min each → parallel wins.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether parallel engine builds justified by coordination cost analysis
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
